title: trailboss --json send
description: One row per chosen agent. action: would send (no --yes), skipped (detail says why), or, once typed: sent (it started a turn; with --no-wait, only that it was typed), held (the agent holds it until the turn under way ends) or no reaction (typed, but it hadn't started a turn when checked; detail says if the message is still in its input box). detail starts with the status the agent was in and adds what the look found, e.g. 'was idle; started a turn'. Frontends should show an action they don't know as is. The message itself is never in the output. agent is null for a selector that found no agent.

action.description: would send, sent, held, no reaction or skipped; more may be added.
